panel_rule: per class AF/BD/MI/UA, choose the 3 ids minimizing exact Fraction abs(q_cal - 1/2), ties by lexical id; full is all 32 manifest ids

claude.model_rule: command-line M must match ^claude-[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9.-]*$ and parent modelUsage keys must equal {M}

pair.attestation_rule: state.pair_verify == true AND codex-judge.stdout present AND header version/model/reasoning effort equal the registered pair values AND state.phases.verify.sub_verdicts.pair_judge non-null
pair.codex_home_rule: auth.json only; zero persisted rollouts in every arm
pair.token_source: integer following tokens used in codex-judge.stdout; total tokens, not output tokens
pair.timeout_rule: sub_verdicts.pair_judge == TIMEOUT is a valid L2 product outcome

bootstrap.rule: resample the class size in the selected panel with replacement within each AF/BD/MI/UA class (3 draws quick, 8 draws full), then average the four class means using exact Fraction arithmetic

token_rule: efficiency total = parent modelUsage OUTPUT tokens + surface envelope modelUsage OUTPUT tokens + codex-judge.stdout tokens used TOTAL tokens; the Codex TOTAL is a conservative L2 over-count and the verdict preserves this asymmetric component breakdown
f_ship_rule: clean complete L0 BARE=f_tree; clean complete harness PASS/PASS_WITH_ISSUES=f_tree; every-arm TIMEOUT, clean incomplete, harness NEEDS_WORK, or harness BLOCKED:*=1/1; infrastructure/attestation failures are replaceable and unscored
